description: Export the XML structure, or one element of it, to a file with the XML Export Options: include the DTD declaration, view the XML afterwards, export from the selected element, untagged tables as CALS, remap break, whitespace and special characters, XSLT, encoding, ruby, and image copying and conversion (File > Export > XML; Structure pane menu > Export XML). The options given are kept as the document's XML export settings

filePath.description: Absolute path of the XML file to write

fromElement.description: Export only this element and its children. An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

fromSelection.description: Export from the element selected in the Structure pane (Export From Selected Element)

formatted.description: Copy optimized formatted (cropped and scaled) images

original.description: Copy original images to the Images folder

remapCharacters.description: Remap Break, Whitespace, and Special Characters as character references

untaggedTables.description: Export Untagged Tables as CALS XML (cals) or not (none)

viewAfterExport.description: Open the exported file afterwards (View XML Using)

viewer.description: Path of the application to view the XML with (View XML Using); must be inside the allowed directories

xslt.description: Apply XSLT (export): a stylesheet file, or the stylesheet named in the XML; enabled: false turns it off

enabled.description: false turns XSLT off (default true when the object is given)

file.description: Absolute path of the XSLT file

useStylesheetInXml.description: Use the stylesheet the XML file names (Use Stylesheet Specified in XML)

name: export_xml
title: Export XML
